# Kill Chain v3.2.1

Fire Command stability audit — live A/B routing, morph/scene scrub fixes, live FX knobs, safer project open, sequencer↔synth bridge, MIDI Focus vs Learn, richer `.kcproj`.

## Install

1. Download `Kill-Chain-Setup-3.2.1.exe` below
2. Run the installer
3. Launch **Kill Chain** from the Start menu

Windows may show SmartScreen — choose **More info** → **Run anyway** if you trust this build.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JerryKoller/Kill-Chain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
